shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----" && find .agents -type f && echo "-----" && cat AGENTS.md && echo "-----" && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null

find src -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "=== {}"; cat {}' && echo "=== tsconfig" && cat tsconfig.json && cat vite.config.ts && cat index.html && echo "=== version" && node -p "require('@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/

grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -5; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ToasterProvider useToaster ToasterComponent Button 2>&1 | head -80

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ToasterProvider useToaster ToasterComponent Button 2>&1 | head -80; echo "-----"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -80; echo "-----"; grep -ril "toaster" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build --include=*.d.ts | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat components/Toaster/index.d.ts components/Toaster/Toaster.d.ts components/Toaster/types.d.ts components/Toaster/hooks/useToaster.d.ts components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts toaster-singleton.d.ts

cat components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts components/Toaster/Toast/Toast.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls components/Toaster; grep -n -i "toaster" index.d.ts components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat components/Toaster/constants.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat components/Toaster/withToaster.d.ts; cat components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterContext.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -n -A12 '"exports"' package.json | head -40; grep -n "toaster" package.json; cat build/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.js | head -60; echo ----; cat build/esm/components/Toaster/Toaster.js | head -80; echo ----; ls build/esm/components/Toaster/ToastList build/esm/components/Toaster/Toast; cat build/esm/components/Toaster/ToastList/*.js | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster && grep -n "autoHiding\|isClosable\|theme" Toast/Toast.js | head -30; echo ----; grep -rn "position\|bottom\|left\|right\|top" ToasterComponent/*.css ToastList/ToastList.css 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls ToasterComponent; echo ----; cat ../../toaster-singleton.js; cat Toast/Toast.js | sed -n 1,30p

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -n 1,20p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToastList/ToastList.css; echo ----; grep -n "view" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head; grep -rn "ButtonView\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo ----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -120

grep -rn "export type ButtonView" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/ | head -3; grep -rn "ButtonView =" -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/*.d.ts | head -10; echo ----; sed -n 120,400p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | grep -n "^##\|^###"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -rn "BUTTON_VIEWS = " build/esm/components/Button/constants.js; grep -rhoE "\-\-g-spacing-(base|[0-9]+)\s*:\s*[^;]+" styles/ 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -20; ls styles
rm -rf dist && git status --short && git diff --stat
